Alistar.combo: After Alistar W Headbutt is down, knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under him, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. Hit both instances of Vel'Koz W Void Rift damage while he is airborne to complete the stacks of Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after building stacks, from an angle where Alistar W Headbutt cannot interrupt it.
Alistar.laning: Stand behind or beside your allied ADC and consistently hit the enemy ADC from the edge of your range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. While Alistar W Headbutt is available, don't walk forward to poke, and save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense. Secure vision in the river and tri-brush before pushing the lane, and keep at least one cast of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight.
Alistar.phase: In the late game, Vel'Koz's true damage becomes more powerful, but he remains fragile, so fight from farther back.
Alistar.teamfight: From the backline, build stacks on multiple enemies with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. Don't focus Alistar while Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active; target the damage dealers behind him. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray when your allies have locked down an enemy and Alistar W Headbutt cannot interrupt you. If Alistar engages, stop him with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption.
Alistar.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Alistar deals mostly magic damage, and Vel'Koz has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Alistar P Triumphant Roar is a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Alistar.escape: The opening to engage is right after Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are down. In particular, make Alistar use Alistar W Headbutt, then hit him with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption to make it hard for him to escape. Before both abilities are ready again, push the lane or return to a safe position.
Alistar.fight: Reposition and retaliate as soon as Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are down. Until then, poke from outside his range with the slow from Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, and hold Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption to stop his engage. When Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, back off and fight again after it expires.
Alistar.watch: Be most careful of Alistar W Headbutt closing the distance, followed by Alistar Q Pulverize and Alistar E Trample to chain the lockdown. Vel'Koz has no mobility, so keep your distance at the edge of your range while Alistar W Headbutt is available. Near a turret, don't give Alistar room to circle behind you and push you under it.

Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns when it hits a wall or a second target, so don't stand with your back to a wall or in a line with an ally or minion. Watch for Bard E Magical Journey to enter from the side, and deal damage after the damage immunity from Bard R Tempered Fate ends.
Bard.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Bard's main damage is magic, and Vel'Koz has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Bard.combo: When Bard E Magical Journey is down, knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under him, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. This sequence triggers the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after building stacks, from a safe angle.
Bard.escape: The moment after you force Bard to use Bard E Magical Journey is an opportunity to close the distance. Avoid the stun angle from Bard Q Cosmic Binding, then catch Bard with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption.
Bard.fight: Use Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift from the edge of your range to chip away at health. If Bard E Magical Journey is available, hold Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense, and look to knock him up after the portal is down.
Bard.laning: Poke the enemy ADC steadily from behind or beside your allied ADC, and save at least one cast of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight. Walk over visible Bard W Caretaker's Shrine to remove it.
Bard.phase: Your damage increases in the late game, but you remain fragile, so position farther back.
Bard.teamfight: From the very back, build stacks on multiple enemies with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. After your allies lock down an enemy and you confirm there is no risk of an engage through Bard E Magical Journey, use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.

Janna.escape: Go in during a window when Janna Q Howling Gale is down and Janna R Monsoon can’t push you away. If Janna is away from her allied damage dealer, knock her up first with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and follow with your combo. Janna W Zephyr increases her movement speed, so don’t rely on minions to block her path.
Janna.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vel'Koz has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance to prepare for Janna's magic damage. If the healing from Janna R Monsoon becomes a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Janna.combo: Knock up a target whose Janna E Eye Of The Storm shield is gone with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, then immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under their feet and layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. Cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift right away so both its initial damage and its second explosion hit while the target is airborne. Build up Organic Deconstruction stacks, then finish with Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray from a safe angle.
Janna.fight: Draw out Janna E Eye Of The Storm, then focus your damage on a target without a shield. If Janna Q Howling Gale is down, pressure from max range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. When Janna is away and her means of pushing you back is down, knock the target up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and continue attacking.
Janna.laning: Poke from max range behind or beside your allied ADC, pressuring the ally Janna is protecting to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm. Making Janna waste Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr is a good way to gain lane control. Keep at least one charge of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight, and save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption as a defensive tool for when you’re in danger.
Janna.phase: In the late game, Vel'Koz’s damage keeps increasing, but he is still fragile, so fight from farther back.
Janna.teamfight: Stay far behind and build Organic Deconstruction stacks on multiple targets with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. Janna R Monsoon can push enemies away, so save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for a chance to interrupt it. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray when your allies have locked down an enemy and you can channel safely.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale knocks you up, so move out of its line if you hear the tornado from out of sight. Don’t dump all your damage at once into a target affected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm. Janna R Monsoon pushes enemies away and heals her allies, so save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption to interrupt it as she casts it.

Blitzcrank.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to prepare for the magic damage from Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank R Static Field. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Magic resistance won't block the physical damage from Blitzcrank E Power Fist, so keep your distance after buying it to avoid being caught.
Blitzcrank.fight: Trade from the edge of your range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift immediately after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or when Blitzcrank is low on mana. If Blitzcrank can approach, don't use Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption first; save it for self-defense. After Blitzcrank uses his way to catch you and you have an angle to engage, knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and continue your attack.
Blitzcrank.combo: When the threat of Blitzcrank's grab is gone and you can use Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption offensively, knock him up with E, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under him, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission last. This sequence triggers the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction, then finishes with Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray. Blitzcrank P Mana Barrier may activate, so don't chase recklessly if you have no way to finish him.
Blitzcrank.escape: The moment after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is an opportunity for Vel'Koz to move forward and trade. If Blitzcrank E Power Fist and the crowd control from Blitzcrank R Static Field are also down, engage with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and use your combo. Until then, save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption as an escape tool.
Blitzcrank.laning: Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab only pulls the first target it hits, so stand with minions between Blitzcrank and Vel'Koz. Poke from the edge of your range behind or beside your allied ADC, and stay far from a brush if you don't have vision of it. If the grab misses, use that opening to push the lane or trade.
Blitzcrank.phase: In the late game, Vel'Koz's true damage becomes more powerful, but he remains fragile, so fight from farther back.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: From the backline, build stacks on multiple enemies with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. Avoid angles where Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab can catch you, and activate Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after the enemy's engage tools are down or your allies have locked down an enemy. Slowly move the ray along one target's path to keep hitting them.

Hwei.phase: In the late game, Vel'Koz deals more true damage, but he is fragile, so fight from farther back. The available information is not enough to determine who has the advantage against Hwei at each stage.
Hwei.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei deals mostly magic damage, and Vel'Koz has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Hwei.combo: After Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, knock the target up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under them, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. This sequence completes the stacks of Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after building stacks and confirming you have a safe angle to cast.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility, so the moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or waveclear is an opportunity to engage. Catch him then with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and layer your follow-up spells. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense.
Hwei.fight: Poke from the edge of your range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission, and catch Hwei with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption when Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. Also check whether Hwei W Subject: Serenity's shield and movement speed bonus are still active before choosing when to attack.
Hwei.laning: Once you have learned Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, poke from the edge of your range, but keep at least one cast of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight. Don't use Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for simple poke; save it to respond to Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Hwei.teamfight: Build stacks on multiple enemies from the backline with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. After Hwei E Subject: Torment is down and your allies have locked down an enemy, activate Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray and keep hitting one target for a long time. You are vulnerable while casting, so first check whether you could be caught from behind.
Hwei.watch: If you are caught by the root or forced movement from Hwei E Subject: Torment, you are likely to take his follow-up attacks as well. If Hwei's first spell hits you, move immediately to avoid his second spell and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Also watch out for the slow from Hwei R Spiraling Despair.

Ashe.build: Buy Cloth Armor first to survive the early game. Ashe deals mostly physical damage, and Vel'Koz has low armor, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Ashe.combo: When Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption knocks Ashe up, cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under her, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission last because it has a delayed impact. Build stacks first even when finishing her with Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Ashe.escape: Ashe has no mobility, so look for an angle to hit her with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption while Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and Ashe W Volley are both down. Vel'Koz also has no mobility, and if Ashe P Frost Shot catches you, it is hard to walk away, so don't walk into Ashe's basic attack range and stay there for long.
Ashe.fight: Try to trade after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has expired. Ashe has no mobility, so pressure her from the edge of your range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, then knock her up and continue attacking when you have an angle to hit with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption.
Ashe.laning: Once you have learned Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, steadily whittle down Ashe's health, but keep at least one cast of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight. Prioritize using Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for self-defense over simple poke or waveclear.
Ashe.phase: In the late game, Vel'Koz's true damage becomes more powerful, but he remains fragile, so fight from farther back.
Ashe.teamfight: Build stacks from the very back with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. After your allies lock down Ashe and you confirm she has no angle to hit you with Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, activate Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray and aim slowly along Ashe's path.
Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley applies an area slow, so sidestep the cone and use the moment it is down to trade. Ashe P Frost Shot refreshes its slow with each basic attack, so don't stay within basic attack range for long. While Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, don't start a skirmish from outside vision; change direction to dodge if the arrow comes your way.

Brand.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Brand's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and prioritize magic resistance.
Brand.combo: If Brand W Pillar of Flame is down and Brand remains in range, knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. As he is knocked up, cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under him, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission last to trigger the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction. Build stacks first even when finishing him with Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility, so the moment after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down is an opportunity to close the distance. Catch him with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption when you are not ablaze, so Brand Q Sear cannot stun you.
Brand.fight: After Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, deal damage from the edge of your range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift to complete the stacks of Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction. Brand has no mobility, so close the distance when you are not ablaze, which prevents Brand Q Sear from stunning you, and look for a chance to knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after building stacks, when you can cast it safely.
Brand.laning: Hold the edge of your range behind or beside your allied ADC and steadily poke with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. Don't stand beside minions Brand has set ablaze; if the wave is ablaze, move to the side. Don't use Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for simple poke or waveclear; save it so you can defend yourself.
Brand.phase: In the late game, Vel'Koz's damage keeps increasing, but he remains fragile, so fight from farther back.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out from your allies to avoid Brand E Conflagration spreading and Brand R Pyroclasm bouncing, and don't stand beside an ally who is burning. Build stacks from the backline with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, then use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray when your allies lock down an enemy. Before activating the ray, make sure there is no risk of being caught from behind.
Brand.watch: If Brand W Pillar of Flame or Brand Q Sear hits you first, it applies stacks of Brand P Blaze and makes his follow-up abilities dangerous. While you are ablaze, Brand Q Sear stuns, so move out of the projectile's path or take cover behind minions. If Brand R Pyroclasm appears, spread out from your allies; if you are ablaze, move earlier to prepare for the slow.

Braum.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to survive, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance because Braum's main damage is magic, but tenacity is also important for Vel'Koz, who has no mobility and needs to prepare for the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows and the knock-up from Braum R Glacial Fissure.
Braum.combo: After Braum W Stand Behind Me is down and Braum E Unbreakable has ended, knock the target up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under them, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission last. Hitting both instances of Vel'Koz W Void Rift damage while the target is airborne leads into the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after building stacks, from a position where you can avoid Braum's engage.
Braum.escape: The moment after Braum W Stand Behind Me is down is an opportunity to close the distance and target the ally he was protecting. If Braum E Unbreakable has ended and Braum R Glacial Fissure is also down, start your combo with a knock-up from Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. If a Braum P Concussive Blows mark is already on you, don't engage; get out of range before the stun stacks are complete.
Braum.fight: While Braum W Stand Behind Me is available, don't use Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for simple poke; save it to respond to an enemy engage. After Braum E Unbreakable goes down, pressure the target Braum is protecting from the edge of your range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. If Braum W Stand Behind Me is down, look for a chance to land a knock-up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and focus your damage.
Braum.laning: Braum Q Winter's Bite only hits the first enemy it strikes, so avoid leaving a clear line between you and Braum and keep minions between you. Poke from the edge of your range behind or beside your allied ADC, and save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for Braum's engage. Don't spend both casts of Vel'Koz W Void Rift on minions; save at least one cast for a fight.
Braum.phase: In the late game, Vel'Koz's true damage becomes more powerful, but he remains fragile, so fight from farther back.
Braum.teamfight: From the backline, build stacks with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift while avoiding the straight path of Braum R Glacial Fissure. Don't fire projectiles in the direction Braum E Unbreakable faces; target the ally Braum is protecting when his shield drops or you have an angle from the side. After Braum W Stand Behind Me is down and your allies have locked down an enemy, activate Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray and keep it on one target.
Braum.watch: If Braum Q Winter's Bite or a basic attack hits you and applies a Braum P Concussive Blows mark, get out of range before the stun triggers. Projectiles are blocked in the direction Braum E Unbreakable faces, so throw Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission after his shield comes down. Braum R Glacial Fissure travels in a straight line, so watch its cast animation and dodge sideways; also avoid the slow zone it leaves behind.

Heimerdinger.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Heimerdinger's main damage is magic, and Vel'Koz has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Heimerdinger.combo: This sequence completes the stacks of Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction and deals true damage. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after building stacks and confirming you are in a safe position.
Heimerdinger.escape: Approach from the side, past a newly placed turret or one that has just fired a powerful shot, and hit Heimerdinger with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption.
Heimerdinger.fight: Don't trade head-on in front of the turrets; hit with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift from the edge of your range. Heimerdinger has no mobility, so you can follow up well after hitting him with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption.
Heimerdinger.laning: Don't stand in Heimerdinger's turret setup for long, and push him back instead of spending time destroying his turrets one by one. Poke with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, but keep at least one cast of Vel'Koz W Void Rift in reserve. Don't use Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for simple poke; use it for self-defense or an opportunity to attack after dodging his grenade.
Heimerdinger.phase: Your damage keeps increasing in the late game, but you remain fragile, so fight from farther back.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: From the backline, build stacks on enemies with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. While Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is available, don't bunch up with your allies in a narrow passage or at one point in front of an objective. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray when your allies have locked down an enemy and Vel'Koz can safely maintain the ray.
Heimerdinger.watch: If you get hit, immediately move out of turret range.

Karma.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game. Karma's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Karma.combo: While Karma W Focused Resolve is down, knock the target up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under their feet, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. This order triggers the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction. Build stacks first and confirm you have a safe angle before using Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Karma.escape: Close the distance after Karma W Focused Resolve, her root, is down. If Karma’s R Mantra-empowered E shield is active, wait until it ends before engaging with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption.
Karma.fight: Poke from max range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and stay outside Karma W Focused Resolve's tether range. Once Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma E Inspire has ended, knock the target up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and focus your damage on them.
Karma.laning: Poke with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, but reposition so Karma can’t land Karma Q Inner Flame for free and speed up the cooldown of Karma R Mantra. Keep at least one charge of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight, and save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption in case Karma approaches.
Karma.phase: In the late game, your true damage becomes stronger, but you remain fragile, so fight from farther back.
Karma.teamfight: Stay far behind and build stacks on multiple targets with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. After Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E has ended, use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray when your allies have locked down an enemy.
Karma.watch: Dodge the slow and area damage from Karma Q Inner Flame, and if you’re hit by the burning zone from Karma R Mantra-empowered Q, leave the area right away. If Karma W Focused Resolve links to you, create distance before the root and break the tether. Karma R Mantra-empowered W heals Karma, so don’t fight for long while tethered.

Leona.build: Early on, use a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Leona’s magic damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Magic resistance is the first resistance to build against Leona, but choose your next resistance based on the damage type of the enemy carry who will attack while Leona has you locked down.
Leona.combo: During a window when Leona E Zenith Blade is down, knock the target up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under their feet, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission last. This order completes Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction stacks and deals true damage. Activate Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after first dealing Organic Deconstruction damage and confirming Leona's engage is down.
Leona.escape: The moment after you make Leona use Leona E Zenith Blade is your window to close the distance and counterattack. Don’t go in first if you’re within range of Leona Q Shield of Daybreak and Leona R Solar Flare; hit with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption after Leona E Zenith Blade is down.
Leona.fight: Chip away at enemies from max range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. While Leona E Zenith Blade is available, save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense and counterattack after that dash is down.
Leona.laning: Poke from behind or beside your allied ADC, and don’t stand in a straight line with your allies so Leona E Zenith Blade can’t pass through them to reach a target farther back. Keep one charge of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight, and secure vision around the river and tri-brush before pushing the lane.
Leona.phase: In the late game, even though Vel'Koz's true damage becomes stronger, he is still fragile, so fight from farther back.
Leona.teamfight: Stay far behind and build stacks on multiple targets with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. After Leona E Zenith Blade is down and your allies have locked down an enemy, use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray along one target’s path. If the Leona P Sunlight mark is applied, the enemy can follow up with damage, so back away immediately.
Leona.watch: If Leona E Zenith Blade hits you, Leona can follow up by getting close and stunning you with Leona Q Shield of Daybreak, so don’t let her get in range. When the marker for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the stun at its center. If Leona activates Leona W Eclipse, move out of its range before it explodes.

Lulu.build: Early on, first use a Null-Magic Mantle to hold out, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lulu's damage is mostly magic, and Vel'Koz has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Lulu.combo: When Lulu W Whimsy is down, knock the target up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under their feet, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission last. This order triggers the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction. Build Organic Deconstruction stacks first, then cast Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray from a safe position.
Lulu.escape: When Lulu uses Lulu W Whimsy on another ally, that’s your chance to engage with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. If Lulu R Wild Growth is also down, there’s less risk of the target being saved or a nearby knock-up. Vel'Koz has no ability to escape on his own, so check your distance before taking an opening.
Lulu.fight: Deal steady damage from max range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift; don't try to break through Lulu's shield all at once. If Lulu E Help, Pix! is used on an allied carry, that's your chance to target Lulu herself. When approaching, knock her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption after Lulu W Whimsy is down.
Lulu.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce the bonus damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion, and poke with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission from behind or beside your allied ADC. Keep at least one charge of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight, and save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense while Lulu W Whimsy is available.
Lulu.phase: In the late game, your true damage becomes stronger, but you remain fragile, so fight from farther back.
Lulu.teamfight: Stay far behind and build Organic Deconstruction stacks on multiple targets with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. Cast Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray when your allies have locked down an enemy and there’s less chance for Lulu to disrupt you. If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, target Lulu herself or another enemy instead of trying to finish the target Lulu is protecting.
Lulu.watch: Lulu W Whimsy prevents you from using abilities and attacking, so don’t start a fight with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption while it is available. Lulu R Wild Growth saves its target and knocks up nearby enemies, so check whether Lulu can use it before casting Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.

Lux.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Lux’s damage is mostly magic, and Vel'Koz has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance early.
Lux.combo: After Lux Q Light Binding misses, knock her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under her feet to overlap the two hits. Layer the slower Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission last to trigger the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction. When finishing off a target, build Organic Deconstruction stacks first, then channel Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray on one target.
Lux.escape: Your window to engage on Lux is right after Lux Q Light Binding misses. Lux has no mobility ability, so if you close the distance, knock her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and follow with more attacks.
Lux.fight: Chip away at enemies from max range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. After dodging Lux Q Light Binding, start a damage trade by knocking her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. Lux has no mobility ability, so if you close the distance and land E, it’s easy to follow up with more attacks.
Lux.laning: Stand spread out to the side of your allies to dodge Lux Q Light Binding, and pressure from max range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. Keep at least one charge of W for a fight, and don’t use E Tectonic Disruption for casual poke while Lux Q is available.
Lux.phase: In the late game, Vel'Koz’s true damage keeps increasing, but he is fragile, so fight from farther back.
Lux.teamfight: Stay far behind and build Organic Deconstruction stacks with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. Don’t group with your allies so Lux E Lucent Singularity can’t catch you together. After your allies lock down an enemy and you dodge Lux Q Light Binding, cast R Life Form Disintegration Ray and keep the beam on one target.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, it’s difficult to dodge her follow-up abilities, so don’t stand in a straight line with your allies and bait out Q to dodge it. If you’re hit by one of Lux’s abilities, create distance so she can’t trigger the Illumination mark with a basic attack. Dodge sideways when you see the red targeting line from Lux R Final Spark.

Maokai.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance against Maokai’s main damage, and if the healing from Maokai P Sap Magic becomes a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Maokai.combo: After Maokai W Twisted Advance is down, knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under his feet, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. This order completes Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction stacks and deals true damage. Build stacks first, then cast Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray from an angle where Maokai can’t root you again.
Maokai.escape: The moment after you make Maokai use Maokai W Twisted Advance is your chance to move forward or pick him off. If you’ve also dodged Maokai R Nature's Grasp, you can fight with less risk of being rooted.
Maokai.fight: While Maokai W Twisted Advance is available, fight from max range and save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense.
Maokai.laning: From behind or beside your allied ADC, hit the enemy damage dealer with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift to chip away at their health. If you keep hitting Maokai with abilities, Maokai P Sap Magic’s healing comes back sooner, so choose your poke target carefully. Secure vision around the river and tri-brush before pushing the lane, and don’t go near bushes while Maokai W Twisted Advance is available.
Maokai.phase: In the late game, your true damage grows along with your ability power, but you’re fragile, so fight from farther back.
Maokai.teamfight: Stay far behind and build Organic Deconstruction stacks on multiple enemies with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. If Maokai R Nature's Grasp appears, dodge sideways in open terrain and check whether Maokai W Twisted Advance is down. After your allies lock down an enemy, cast Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray from a safe position and keep the beam on one target.
Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance roots Vel'Koz and leaves him open to follow-up attacks, so don’t close the distance near bushes while it’s available. Don’t enter bushes where Maokai E Sapling Toss has placed a sapling, and if Maokai R Nature's Grasp comes from afar, dodge perpendicular to its path.

Milio.build: Early on, use a Null-Magic Mantle to hold out, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. The damage from Milio P Fired Up! and Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is magic, so build magic resistance. If the healing from Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life becomes a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Milio.combo: After Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under his feet, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. If you follow with Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray, deal Organic Deconstruction damage first, then activate it.
Milio.escape: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is his only way to disengage, so the moment after he uses it is your chance to go in. If you close the distance, knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. Milio R Breath of Life can’t remove knock-ups, so this engage is still available even if his ultimate is up.
Milio.fight: Chip away at enemies from max range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, repeating trades that complete your Organic Deconstruction stacks. When Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, take the chance to close the distance on Milio and knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. Build stacks first, then use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray from a safe angle.
Milio.laning: After learning both Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, keep poking the enemy ADC to put pressure on Milio’s healing. Stay at max range behind or beside your allied ADC, and save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption in case an enemy closes in.
Milio.phase: Milio’s team gets stronger as the game goes on, so win the attrition fight and wave control early; in the late game, fight from farther back even as Vel'Koz’s damage grows.
Milio.teamfight: Stay far behind and build Organic Deconstruction stacks on multiple targets with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. While Milio W Cozy Campfire increases the enemy ADC’s range, delay the frontline fight. Once your allies have locked down an enemy and you have a safe angle, cast Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray. When you have a chance to kill Milio, target him first to cut off the enemy’s healing.
Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back and slows the first enemy it hits, so don’t take a forward position to look for an engage while it’s available. If Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and increases the enemy ADC’s range, delay the frontline fight. The shield and movement speed from Milio E Warm Hugs, along with the healing from Milio R Breath of Life, can also prolong a fight.

Morgana.build: Early on, withstand Morgana’s magic damage with Null-Magic Mantle. Choose Mercury’s Treads to prepare for roots and stuns. If Morgana heals through Morgana P Soul Siphon and Morgana W Tormented Shadow and the fight drags on, cut her healing with Morellonomicon.
Morgana.combo: When Morgana E Black Shield is down, knock her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift at her feet, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. Cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift right away so its first hit and second explosion land while she is airborne. After completing Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction with this sequence, activate Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray to deal true damage.
Morgana.escape: The window to start a fight with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is right after Morgana Q Dark Binding misses and Morgana E Black Shield is down. Morgana has no ability to create distance on her own, so if you catch her then, it’s hard for her to escape. Vel'Koz has no mobility, so don’t close the distance while Morgana’s binding is available.
Morgana.fight: Keep enough distance to dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding while harassing with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. Don’t waste Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield.
Morgana.laning: Keep minions between you and Morgana, and harass from the edge of Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission’s range while standing behind or beside your allied ADC. Don’t use both casts of Vel'Koz W Void Rift on the wave; save one for a fight. While Morgana Q Dark Binding is a threat, hold Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense.
Morgana.phase: In the late game, Vel'Koz’s true damage increases, but he remains fragile, so fight from farther back.
Morgana.teamfight: From the farthest back position, build Deconstruction stacks on multiple targets with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. Check that Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana R Soul Shackles can’t catch you, and activate Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after your allies lock down an enemy. Don’t waste Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield.
Morgana.watch: Morgana Q Dark Binding only catches the first target it hits, so avoid it with a minion between you and her. If your health is low, getting caught on Morgana W Tormented Shadow is dangerous, so watch your retreat path too. If Morgana R Soul Shackles catches you, get out of range before you are stunned.

Nami.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Nami’s damage is mostly magic, and Vel'Koz has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize building magic resistance. If the healing from Nami W Ebb and Flow is difficult to deal with, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Nami.combo: After Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, if you have an angle to reach Nami, knock her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under her feet. Follow with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission to trigger the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction. Build Organic Deconstruction stacks and check for Nami’s catch abilities before using Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Nami.escape: Nami has no mobility ability, so the moment after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is your chance to close the distance. Against an enemy affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing, wait until the effect ends before fighting. When you have an opening to go in, knock Nami up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and follow up.
Nami.fight: Look for an opening right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, and poke from max range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. Nami has low health and no mobility ability, so secure vision before looking for an angle on her. If you’re caught by Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave, it’s easy for follow-up attacks to hit, so use Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption carefully to keep it available for defense.
Nami.laning: Poke from behind or beside your allied ADC, and keep one charge of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight. Secure vision around the river and tri-brush before pushing the lane, and keep up steady pressure on Nami to account for the healing from Nami W Ebb and Flow.
Nami.phase: In the late game, Vel'Koz’s true damage keeps increasing, but he is fragile, so fight from farther back.
Nami.teamfight: Stay far behind and build Organic Deconstruction stacks on multiple targets with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. Avoid positions where Nami R Tidal Wave and Nami Q Aqua Prison can catch you, and cast Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after your allies lock down an enemy. Keep the beam along the locked-down target’s path instead of changing its angle abruptly.
Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison stuns you on hit and sets up follow-up attacks, so dodge sideways when you see its landing indicator. As soon as you see Nami R Tidal Wave, move sideways to avoid being knocked up. Don’t fight head-on against an enemy affected by Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing; keep your distance until it ends.

Nautilus.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. Since Nautilus’s main damage is magic, build magic resistance first.
Nautilus.combo: When Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift at his feet, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission last. This sequence completes Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction stacks. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after building stacks and from a position where Nautilus Q Dredge Line can’t interrupt you.
Nautilus.escape: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses is your window to trade. Slow Nautilus with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and create distance before he can close in again. If Nautilus Q Dredge Line is available, hold Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense.
Nautilus.fight: Immediately after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses, keep your distance and trade with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. While Nautilus Q Dredge Line is available, don’t use Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption to harass; save it to stop his engage.
Nautilus.laning: Harass from the edge of your range while standing behind or beside your allied ADC, and keep a minion between you and Nautilus’s Q Dredge Line. Save one cast of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight, and secure vision in the river and tri-brush before pushing the wave. Keep hitting the enemy ADC with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift to wear down their health.
Nautilus.phase: In the late game, Vel'Koz’s damage keeps increasing, but he remains fragile, so fight from farther back.
Nautilus.teamfight: From the farthest back position, build stacks first with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after your allies lock down an enemy and you’ve checked that Nautilus Q Dredge Line can’t catch you. If Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, don’t stand with your allies in the path of his engage.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line leads into a stun and a dash, making it dangerous for immobile Vel'Koz, so manage your distance and angle and keep a minion between you and Nautilus to avoid it. Nautilus P Staggering Blow roots you at close range, so don’t stay within his basic attack range. Nautilus R Depth Charge follows its target and knocks up allies along its path, so don’t stand on top of your allies.

Neeko.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. Neeko’s main damage is magic and Vel'Koz has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Tenacity is especially important if Neeko E Tangle-Barbs catches you and she follows up with Neeko R Pop Blossom.
Neeko.combo: Right after knocking an enemy up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift at their feet, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission last. Cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift immediately so both hits land while the target is airborne, leading into Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction’s true damage. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after building Deconstruction stacks and once the threat of Neeko R Pop Blossom’s engage has passed.
Neeko.escape: If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is also down, the risk of being rooted is lower, so try to trade from within your range. If Neeko R Pop Blossom is available, hold Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense.
Neeko.fight: Vel'Koz wears down enemies from the edge of his range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. While Neeko R Pop Blossom is available, hold Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption to stop her engage. Trade with your combo once Neeko’s engage is down and you can land Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption.
Neeko.laning: Harass from the edge of your range while standing behind or beside your allied ADC, and spread out so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can’t root both of you. Don’t use both casts of Vel'Koz W Void Rift on minions; save one for a fight. Secure vision in the river and tri-brush before pushing the wave.
Neeko.phase: Once you’ve learned both Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, build Deconstruction stacks to pressure the lane.
Neeko.teamfight: From the farthest back position, build Deconstruction stacks on multiple enemies with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after the threat from Neeko R Pop Blossom has passed and your allies have locked down an enemy.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up if it hits something first, so don’t stand on top of an ally or in a line with them. If an enemy transformed with Neeko P Inherent Glamour approaches, start creating distance before the cast animation for Neeko R Pop Blossom appears. Don’t chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; watch the real Neeko’s position.

Pantheon.build: Early on, hold out with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Pantheon’s main damage is physical, while Vel'Koz has low armor, so build armor first. Buy Zhonya’s Hourglass if you need a way to avoid his engage.
Pantheon.combo: After Pantheon’s engage ability is down, knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift at his feet to land both hits, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. After completing Deconstruction stacks, finish by tracking one target with Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Pantheon.escape: Your window to start attacking is after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is available again. Knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption then and follow up with more attacks. If only one of Pantheon’s mobility abilities is down, check for his remaining engage ability and keep your distance.
Pantheon.fight: While Pantheon W Shield Vault is available, hold Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense and harass from the edge of your range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. When Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, don’t deal damage from the front; wait for it to end or look for an angle from the side.
Pantheon.laning: Keep a minion between you and Pantheon Q Comet Spear, and cast your abilities from the edge of your range while standing behind or beside your allied ADC. Save one cast of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon’s influence falls off in the late game, but Vel'Koz remains fragile, so fight from farther back.
Pantheon.teamfight: From the farthest back position, build Deconstruction stacks with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. After your allies lock down an enemy, activate Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray once you’ve checked for the engage threats from Pantheon W Shield Vault and Pantheon R Grand Starfall.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun, so you can’t dodge it once you give him engage range. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of the landing area, and use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray only after you’ve accounted for both of his engage abilities.

Pyke.build: Early on, hold out with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Pyke’s damage is mostly physical and Vel'Koz has low armor, so build armor first, but watch your health so it stays above the threshold for Pyke R Death From Below. Since Pyke is an engage threat, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass too.
Pyke.combo: While Pyke E Phantom Undertow and Pyke R Death From Below are down, knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift at his feet, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. Complete Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction stacks with this sequence, then activate Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray to aim for true damage.
Pyke.escape: Your chance to engage comes after dodging the stun from Pyke E Phantom Undertow to the side. If Pyke R Death From Below is also down and hasn’t returned, land Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption so Pyke can’t escape. If only Pyke E Phantom Undertow is down, keep your distance while watching for his remaining mobility.
Pyke.fight: While Pyke E Phantom Undertow is available, don’t use Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption to harass; save it to deal with an engage. If you dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow, keep your distance with the slow from Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and layer and land Vel'Koz W Void Rift. Activate Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray when Pyke’s engage options are down and there is no angle for you to be caught from behind.
Pyke.laning: Cast Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift from the edge of your range while standing behind or beside your allied ADC. Save one cast of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight, and keep Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption ready for Pyke’s engage. If you keep vision as Pyke retreats, you can prevent Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones from healing him.
Pyke.phase: In the late game, Vel'Koz’s true damage becomes substantial, but he remains fragile, so fight from farther back.
Pyke.teamfight: From the farthest back position, build Deconstruction stacks with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, then activate Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after your allies lock down an enemy. If Pyke still has an engage ability available, hold Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense. Don’t stand near low-health allies, so Pyke R Death From Below can’t chain through them.
Pyke.watch: If Pyke Q Bone Skewer pulls you in, Pyke E Phantom Undertow can easily follow with a stun, so stay at the edge of your range. When Pyke E Phantom Undertow starts, dodge sideways from the direction Pyke came from. If you see a shark shadow beneath your feet, Pyke W Ghostwater Dive is already nearby, so retreat toward your allies or under your turret.

Rakan.build: Rakan’s damage is mostly magic and Vel'Koz has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads.
Rakan.combo: When Rakan W Grand Entrance is down and the engage threat is lower, knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift at his feet, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission last. This sequence completes Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction stacks and deals true damage. Activate Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after building stacks, once Rakan’s engage abilities are down and you’ve confirmed you have a safe position.
Rakan.escape: Your window to pressure Rakan is right after you bait out Rakan W Grand Entrance and dodge its landing. Since Rakan E Battle Dance can only target allied champions, look for a chance to catch him with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption when he’s alone, separated from his allies.
Rakan.fight: Trade right after the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers is removed. While Rakan W Grand Entrance is available, hold Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense. After dodging his engage, keep your distance with the slow from Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and attack.
Rakan.laning: Wear down the enemy ADC with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift from the edge of your range while standing behind or beside your allied ADC. Save one cast of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight, and don’t waste Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption on simple harassment while preparing for Rakan W Grand Entrance. Secure vision in the river and tri-brush before pushing the wave.
Rakan.phase: In the late game, Vel'Koz’s true damage becomes substantial, but he remains fragile, so fight from farther back.
Rakan.teamfight: From the farthest back position, build Deconstruction stacks on multiple enemies with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. If Rakan engages with Rakan W Grand Entrance, dodge its landing and respond with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. After your allies lock down an enemy and Rakan’s engage threat is down, activate Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance dashes in and knocks up at its landing point, so sidestep when Rakan starts moving. When Rakan R The Quickness is active, it’s hard to escape on foot, so put terrain between you or stop him with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption before he reaches you. Don’t stand in a line with your allies.

Rell.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. Rell’s main damage is magic and Vel'Koz has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Rell.combo: When Rell’s mobility ability is down and you can land your abilities, knock her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift at her feet, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission last. Cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift as soon as you knock her up so both hits follow. After building Deconstruction stacks, finish with Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray from a safe angle.
Rell.escape: If Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down misses, first create distance so Rell is left alone. Your chance to attack comes when Rell E Full Tilt is also down and before it becomes available again; if you land Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption then, it’s hard for Rell to escape. If only one of her mobility abilities is down, consider her remaining options and don’t rush your engage.
Rell.fight: Wear down Rell with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift from outside the range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. If Rell still has an engage ability available, don’t use Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption to harass; save it to interrupt her engage. Create distance after Rell uses a mobility ability, and look to attack when her escape options are down.
Rell.laning: Harass from the edge of your range while standing behind or beside your allied ADC, and don’t step forward when Rell is looking to engage. Rell has low magic resistance early and no way to recover health in lane, so keep wearing her down from outside her engage range. Save at least one cast of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight, and secure vision in the river and tri-brush before pushing the wave.
Rell.phase: Your damage keeps increasing in the late game, but you remain fragile, so fight from farther back.
Rell.teamfight: Before a fight, spread out from your allies so Rell R Magnet Storm can’t pull you in together. From the farthest back position, build stacks with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, and check whether Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down and Rell E Full Tilt are down. After your allies lock down an enemy, activate Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray from a safe position.
Rell.watch: Watch for Rell to engage with Rell E Full Tilt when she approaches mounted or when she and an ally speed up together. Move out of range of Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down, and dodge Rell Q Shattering Strike by stepping to the side from its line. Keep your distance from allies so Rell R Magnet Storm can’t pull multiple of you in.

Renata.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. Renata Glasc’s damage is mostly magic and Vel'Koz has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a champion with strong healing, cut it with Morellonomicon.
Renata.combo: When you have an opening to catch Renata Glasc, knock her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift at her feet, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. This sequence completes Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction stacks and deals true damage. Build Deconstruction stacks before using Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray, and check that Renata Glasc’s disruption abilities are down.
Renata.escape: When Renata Glasc Q Handshake and Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover are down, you have a chance to close the distance. Renata Glasc has no mobility ability of her own, so if you land Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption during that window, it’s hard for her to escape.
Renata.fight: Wear down enemies with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift from the edge of your range, and dodge Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program to the side. If Renata Glasc Q Handshake is available, hold Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense. If her crowd control is down and a chance to close the distance opens up, knock her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and attack.
Renata.laning: Then keep up the pressure with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, but save one cast of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight. Vel'Koz has no mobility, so attack from the edge of your range while standing behind or beside your allied ADC, and keep Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption as a safeguard.
Renata.phase: In the late game, Vel'Koz’s damage keeps increasing, but he remains fragile, so fight from farther back.
Renata.teamfight: While Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep your distance from allies and fight from the farthest back position. Before a fight, build stacks on multiple enemies with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, then use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after your allies lock down an enemy. Before activating the ray, check whether disruptive abilities such as Renata Glasc Q Handshake are down.
Renata.watch: Renata Glasc Q Handshake roots the first target hit and throws them, which can also stun an ally, so dodge it from behind a minion or frontline. While Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep your distance from allies; if you’re hit, use a crowd control cleanse or move away from your allies. Right after killing an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, retreat so they can’t participate in a takedown and fully revive.

Senna.build: Senna's main damage is physical and Vel'Koz has low armor, so build Cloth Armor first to withstand it. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots to increase your armor. If Senna Q Piercing Darkness heals significantly, reduce healing with Morellonomicon.
Senna.combo: When Senna enters range, knock her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under her, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. If both hits of Vel'Koz W Void Rift land while she is knocked up, you can follow through with Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction true damage. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after building Deconstruction stacks, from a safe position.
Senna.escape: Look for a chance to close the distance when Senna W Last Embrace misses and Senna E Curse of the Black Mist is down. Once the distance to Senna has closed, she has a hard time escaping, so lock her down with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. If Senna E Curse of the Black Mist is active, watch for approaches through the mist and back off, or block the approach path with Vel'Koz W Void Rift.
Senna.fight: First chip away at their health from max range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. Harass Senna when she steps forward to collect a soul, and if the distance has closed, knock her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and attack. Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is also needed to protect yourself, so do not walk into a dangerous position first.
Senna.laning: Watch where Senna is going to collect a soul and harass her with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. Move out of the piercing path of Senna Q Piercing Darkness, and use minions as cover when dodging Senna W Last Embrace. Save one cast of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight, and if the enemy's engage is a threat, secure vision in the river and tri-brush before pushing the lane.
Senna.phase: In the late game, Senna P Absolution increases her range and attack damage, and Vel'Koz's true damage also becomes stronger, so fight from farther back and use your range.
Senna.teamfight: From the farthest back position, build Deconstruction stacks on multiple enemies with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, back off to secure vision or cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift into the mist. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray when your allies have locked down the enemy and Vel'Koz is safe.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness pierces allies or minions, and also heals, so move out of the line between Senna and her target. Senna W Last Embrace takes time to root after it hits, so move away from your allies as soon as you are marked. If Senna hits you once, back off to avoid taking a second hit and prevent Senna P Absolution mist collection.

Seraphine.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand her damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Seraphine's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a champion with strong healing, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Seraphine.combo: When Seraphine E Beat Drop is down and you have an angle to hit Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under her as soon as you knock her up, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission last. This completes Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction stacks; finish with Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray from a safe position.
Seraphine.escape: The moment after you let Seraphine E Beat Drop pass without hitting you is your window to start an attack with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. Seraphine has no mobility, so landing the knock-up makes it easy to follow up, but Vel'Koz has no mobility either, so maintain your range before attacking.
Seraphine.fight: The moment after you dodge Seraphine E Beat Drop is your chance to attack. Even though Seraphine has no mobility, Vel'Koz has no escape skill either, so do not force your way closer; pressure her first with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift.
Seraphine.laning: From behind or beside your allied ADC, cast Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift at max range to chip away at the enemy's health. Look for a moment when Seraphine is alone, away from her ADC, but save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption to respond to Seraphine's catch tool.
Seraphine.phase: Your true damage keeps increasing in the late game, but you are still fragile, so fight from farther back.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out to either side of your allies to avoid an angle where Seraphine R Encore can extend through multiple people. Build stacks from the farthest back position with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, then use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray from a safe angle after your allies lock down the enemy.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets, so if you are slowed, move out of the straight line in front of Seraphine. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits an allied champion, so do not line up with your allies.

Sona.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Sona's magic damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If the healing from Sona W Aria of Perseverance is a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Sona.combo: If you get an angle to catch Sona, knock her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under her, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission last. Cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift right away so both hits land while she is knocked up, allowing you to follow through with Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction true damage. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after building Deconstruction stacks, from a safe angle.
Sona.escape: Your chance to engage comes after Sona R Crescendo is down and you have weathered the window when Sona E Song of Celerity creates distance. When Sona steps forward, hit her first with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption to stop her movement, then follow with your combo.
Sona.fight: When Sona steps forward to share her aura, force a trade from max range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. If you get an angle to knock her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption before she escapes with Sona E Song of Celerity, land a full combo.
Sona.laning: Chip away at Sona's health early, while she is weak and has no stacks, to make her spend mana on healing. Harass from behind or beside your allied ADC, and save at least one cast of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight. If the enemy's engage is a threat, save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense.
Sona.phase: Sona's accumulated stacks last permanently, so she gets stronger as the game goes on; look for an early advantage.
Sona.teamfight: Spread out to either side of your allies to avoid getting hit together by Sona R Crescendo, and fight from the farthest back position. Build stacks first with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, then use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray when your allies lock down the enemy. Disrupt Sona's position with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption to separate her from her allies and reduce the number of targets her aura reaches.
Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns multiple enemies in a line, so spread out to either side of your allies and be especially wary when Sona steps forward. If Sona suddenly enters basic attack range, suspect an empowered basic attack from Sona P Power Chord and create distance.

Soraka.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Soraka's damage is mainly magic, so build magic resistance. If healing prolongs fights, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Soraka.combo: When Soraka E Equinox is down, knock her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under her, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. This sequence completes Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction stacks and deals true damage. Build Deconstruction stacks first and check that you are in a safe position before using Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Soraka.escape: Your chance to engage comes when Soraka E Equinox is down after she used it to harass. Use Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption to knock Soraka up before stepping into the area. Soraka has no mobility, so once you close the distance, focus your damage with a combo.
Soraka.fight: When Soraka E Equinox is down, use the slow from Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission to control the distance, then knock her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and deal a quick burst of damage. Soraka has no mobility, but hitting Soraka Q Starcall grants her movement speed, so fight while dodging it.
Soraka.laning: Pressure the enemy ADC with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift to make Soraka use Soraka W Astral Infusion. This heal costs Soraka her own health, so keep up the pressure while dodging Soraka Q Starcall. Save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption in case the enemy engages, and harass from max range behind or beside your allied ADC.
Soraka.phase: Vel'Koz's damage keeps increasing in the late game, but he is still fragile, so fight from farther back.
Soraka.teamfight: Focus Soraka herself instead of repeatedly hitting the ally she is healing. Build stacks from the very back with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, then use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray when your allies lock down Soraka. You are vulnerable while channeling the ray, so check for a safe angle and track Soraka slowly as you aim.
Soraka.watch: Soraka Q Starcall slows you, heals Soraka, and grants her movement speed, so dodge it in lane while harassing her. Soraka E Equinox can silence and root you if you enter its area, so check its position before using Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray too. Soraka R Wish heals her allies regardless of distance, so keep it in mind when going for a finish.

Swain.build: Swain's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build Morellonomicon later to reduce healing from Swain P Ravenous Flock and Swain R Demonic Ascension.
Swain.combo: If Swain E Nevermove is down, knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under him, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. This sequence triggers Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction true damage. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after dealing Deconstruction damage, once you have confirmed there is no angle for Swain to disrupt you.
Swain.escape: Engage after dodging even the returning wave of Swain E Nevermove, or immediately after the ability is down. Swain has no way to create distance, so slow him with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and catch him with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption.
Swain.fight: Swain Q Death's Hand fires multiple bolts that overlap at close range, so maintain your distance and harass with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. Right after Swain E Nevermove is down, catch him with the slow from Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission, then follow with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. While Swain E Nevermove is available, prioritize using Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense.
Swain.laning: Do not step too far forward to harass, and avoid the entire out-and-back path of Swain E Nevermove. Do not spend both casts of Vel'Koz W Void Rift on minions; save at least one for a fight.
Swain.phase: Swain has few growth stacks early, so Vel'Koz can keep him suppressed with harass. In the mid game, you can find finishing opportunities after learning Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray, but create distance while Swain R Demonic Ascension is active. In the late game, Swain's accumulated maximum health and healing make him harder to kill with the same setup, so apply healing reduction and fight from farther back.
Swain.teamfight: From the very back, hit multiple enemies with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift to spread Deconstruction stacks and healing reduction. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, retreat beyond its range so his healing cannot continue. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray when your allies have locked down the enemy and Vel'Koz can channel safely.
Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove travels out and then returns, so even if you dodge the first wave, stay out of its path until it disappears completely. If you are rooted, he can pull you in and land a combo, so save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense. When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, do not fight near him for long; leave its area and wait for it to end.

Taric.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Taric's damage is mainly magic, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Taric Q Starlight's Touch is a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Taric.combo: When Taric E Dazzle is down and Taric R Cosmic Radiance's damage immunity is not active, knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. Immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under him, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission last to trigger Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction true damage. Build stacks first, and confirm that the damage immunity has ended before using Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Taric.escape: The moment after you dodge Taric E Dazzle is your chance to engage. Taric has no skill to create distance, so you can catch him with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption then.
Taric.fight: After dodging Taric E Dazzle to the side, force a trade from outside his range. Use the slow from Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and the knock-up from Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption to keep Taric from reaching a target for basic attacks. Focus your damage after Taric R Cosmic Radiance's damage immunity ends.
Taric.laning: From behind or beside your allied ADC, pressure the enemy with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift at max range. Manage your distance so Taric cannot stick to minions and use empowered basic attacks from Taric P Bravado, and save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption to respond to a stun.
Taric.phase: Vel'Koz's true damage becomes stronger in the late game, but he remains fragile, so fight from farther back.
Taric.teamfight: From the very back, build Deconstruction stacks on multiple enemies with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. During Taric R Cosmic Radiance's damage immunity, lock down the enemy with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and save your damage. Once the immunity ends and your allies lock down the enemy, activate Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray and aim slowly while tracking one target.
Taric.watch: When you see the tell for Taric E Dazzle, move sideways to dodge it. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance's damage immunity activates, stop attacking and use Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption to lock them down while you wait out its duration.

Thresh.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Thresh's damage is mainly magic and Vel'Koz has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance. Tenacity is also important because Vel'Koz has no mobility and can easily take follow-up hits after Thresh's crowd control.
Thresh.combo: If Thresh's engage tools are down, knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under him, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission last. Cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift right away so both hits land while he is knocked up, and aim to trigger Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction true damage with this combo. Build Deconstruction stacks and confirm you have a safe angle to cast before using Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Thresh.escape: The moment after you dodge Thresh Q Death Sentence is your first chance to close the distance, but if Thresh W Dark Passage is still available, the enemy can escape. Engage with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption when Thresh W Dark Passage is down too. If you would be pulled by Thresh E Flay, maintain your distance first.
Thresh.fight: When Thresh walks forward to collect a soul, trade with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. After dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence to the side, look for a chance to knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption once Thresh W Dark Passage is also down. If the enemy still has an engage tool available, save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense.
Thresh.laning: Harass from behind or beside your allied ADC at max range, and move side to side so you can dodge Thresh Q Death Sentence. Chip away at the enemy's health with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, but do not spend both casts of Vel'Koz W Void Rift on minions; save one. Secure vision in the river and tri-brush before pushing the lane.
Thresh.phase: Vel'Koz's true damage becomes stronger in the late game, but he remains fragile, so fight from farther back.
Thresh.teamfight: Build Deconstruction stacks from the very back with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, then use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after your allies lock down the enemy. First make sure there is no angle for Thresh to catch you using Thresh Q Death Sentence and Thresh W Dark Passage. If you are trapped in Thresh R The Box, decide immediately which direction to break through; if Thresh W Dark Passage is thrown, use your finishing spell immediately or retreat.
Thresh.watch: If you are hit by Thresh Q Death Sentence, you can be caught again after the stun, so move sideways when you see him ready his hook. Avoid the line between Thresh and his allies so Thresh E Flay does not pull you toward them. When Thresh W Dark Passage is thrown, another enemy may join, so reassess your distance.

Xerath.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Xerath's main damage is magic and Vel'Koz has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Xerath.combo: After Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately cast Vel'Koz W Void Rift under him, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. Both hits of Vel'Koz W Void Rift should land while he is knocked up to help complete Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction stacks. Build stacks and confirm you have a safe angle before activating Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is your window to engage. Close the distance then and land Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption to make it hard for Xerath to escape. When you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane's cast animation, Xerath cannot move, so you can dodge or engage on his position.
Xerath.fight: Harass with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission at max range, and close the distance while dodging to the side as Xerath charges Xerath Q Arcanopulse. When Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, start a trade by knocking him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption.
Xerath.laning: Xerath Q Arcanopulse hits even through minions, so harass from behind or beside your allied ADC at max range. If you farm while avoiding heavy damage, Xerath will eventually run out of mana first because his mana costs are high. Then push the lane and call your jungler, but save at least one cast of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight.
Xerath.phase: Vel'Koz's damage keeps increasing in the late game, but he is still fragile, so fight from farther back.
Xerath.teamfight: Build stacks on multiple enemies from the very back with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. Once your allies have locked down the enemy, make sure there is no risk of being hit by Xerath E Shocking Orb or caught from behind, then activate Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray. Do not swing the ray around in a hurry; track one target along the path they will take.
Xerath.watch: If you are stunned by Xerath E Shocking Orb, you can take his entire follow-up, so be most wary of that shot. Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging, change direction and dodge well to the side. Walk out of the area targeted by Xerath W Eye of Destruction too.

Zilean.build: Build a Null-Magic Mantle first to survive the early game, then choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Zilean deals magic damage, so build magic resistance. Tenacity is also important when you’re at risk of being caught by stuns and slows. If the enemy team has a champion with strong healing, reduce it with Morellonomicon.
Zilean.combo: Once Zilean’s bomb combo and Zilean E Time Warp are down, knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption. Immediately open Vel'Koz W Void Rift beneath him, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission last to trigger Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction’s true damage. Follow up with Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray after building stacks and confirming you’re safe.
Zilean.escape: Zilean has no mobility, so the window after his Zilean Q Time Bomb stun combo and Zilean E Time Warp are down is your chance to close the gap. Hit him with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption to lock him down. If a bomb attaches while you have not used Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, move away from your teammates and out of its blast radius.
Zilean.fight: While Zilean can attach two Zilean Q Time Bombs, chip away at his health with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift from maximum range. Once Zilean’s bomb combo and Zilean E Time Warp are down, knock him up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and focus your damage. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray from a safe position after building Organic Deconstruction stacks.
Zilean.laning: Vel'Koz is also low on abilities and mana at this point, so don’t overextend.
Zilean.phase: In the late game, Vel'Koz deals more damage, but he is still fragile, so fight from farther back.
Zilean.teamfight: From the very back, build Organic Deconstruction stacks on multiple targets with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. Use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray when your teammates have locked down an enemy and you’re safe. If it’s hard to finish off a damage dealer affected by Zilean R Chronoshift, switch to Zilean and don’t waste abilities on the target while they’re reviving.
Zilean.watch: Zilean Q Time Bomb stuns when two bombs attach to the same target. When the first bomb attaches, move away from your teammates and out of its blast radius. Be especially wary of the next bomb while slowed by Zilean E Time Warp. Don’t use abilities on a target affected by Zilean R Chronoshift while they are reviving.

Zyra.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, then choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Zyra deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance. Get tenacity as well to prepare for being caught by Zyra E Grasping Roots and Zyra R Stranglethorns and hit by follow-up damage.
Zyra.combo: When Zyra E Grasping Roots is down, knock her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, immediately open Vel'Koz W Void Rift beneath her, then layer Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission. This sequence completes Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction stacks and deals true damage. Build Organic Deconstruction stacks before using Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray, and make sure Zyra has no angle to catch you.
Zyra.escape: Zyra has no mobility, so the moment after you dodge Zyra E Grasping Roots is your chance to close the gap. Knock her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, but walk out first if you see the area of Zyra R Stranglethorns.
Zyra.fight: Chip away at her health from maximum range with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift. When Zyra E Grasping Roots misses and there are no nearby plants, knock her up with Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and focus your damage. Save Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption for defense while Zyra still has a way to catch you.
Zyra.laning: Repeat your maximum-range poke from behind or beside your allied marksman. After dodging Zyra E Grasping Roots sideways, pressure her with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift while her counterattack is weaker. Keep at least one cast of Vel'Koz W Void Rift for a fight. If Zyra uses an ability to grow seeds, don’t walk in to step on them; fall back.
Zyra.phase: Your damage increases in the late game, but you remain fragile, so attack from farther back.
Zyra.teamfight: Don’t take a fight in an area where Zyra has stored seeds; move elsewhere. Build stacks from the very back with Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission and Vel'Koz W Void Rift, then use Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray when your teammates lock down an enemy. Before activating the beam, check that Zyra E Grasping Roots is down and that there is no angle for you to be caught from behind.
Zyra.watch: If you’re rooted by Zyra E Grasping Roots, it’s easy to get hit by Zyra Q Deadly Spines and plant damage afterward, so dodge by moving sideways at maximum range. When the summon indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns appears, walk out of its area before you’re knocked up. Don’t fight where her plants have gathered; briefly fall back.
